title: report
body:
## report

Publish an ordered report with a visible title, sections, plain paragraphs, rectangular text tables, captured PNG figures and retained whisper.cpp transcripts as standalone HTML and editable Word DOCX. Use it for small measured-result reports and verified transcripts. Trusted JSON AST, sandboxed writers, independent HTML/OOXML inspection and fresh DOCX native readback retain actual declared content. Default typography and pagination are not an exact layout or accessibility contract. An optional epub declaration (language only) adds an EPUB 3 publication from the same model, checked by independent package and content inspection and a fresh Pandoc EPUB readback. An optional metadata object (authors and description, plain text only) is carried by the HTML, Word and optional EPUB publications and read back from each; these are your declarations, never verified identity.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Replace each image placeholder with an absolute regular plain RGB/RGBA PNG path.
- Begin headings at level 1 and avoid increasing by more than 1.
- Every table row must have one text cell per column; numeric values must be written as strings.
- No authored markup, templates, filters, scripts, rich text or arbitrary input-document conversion.
- For a transcript or captions, write each time as literal digits and label the column with its unit, for example Start (ms); the report never parses, converts or reorders times. Put one utterance in one cell: line breaks, control characters and unsupported formatting characters (bidirectional overrides, embeddings and isolates, word joiner, byte order mark, stray tag characters, and a zero-width space outside Thai, Lao, Myanmar or Khmer text) are refused, while ZWNJ, ZWJ, left/right-to-left marks and emoji flag sequences are kept, so split a multi-line utterance into separate rows.
- To publish a transcript, name a retained machine-draft segments.json or a declared reviewed/1, reviewed/2 or reviewed/3 publication, directly or through a text artifact. The file is captured at run time. Provenance distinguishes machine draft from an author-declared review; status never certifies who reviewed or heard the recording. Nonempty transcripts show exact cue text and millisecond-exact times in the selected format. An all-cues-deleted reviewed/2 or reviewed/3 publication shows explicit provenance without a table, with bound transcriptObservations describing that shape. Oversize or changed evidence is refused, never truncated or repaired.
- Declare epub with a plain language tag to also publish report.epub; the EPUB claim is a bounded package and content proof, not EPUBCheck, device rendering or accessibility conformance, and without epub no EPUB is produced.
- In a workflow an image block source may be an image artifact reference such as {"$artifact":"decode","index":0} (index 0 of the WebP decodeToPng route is its PNG). The workflow checks the artifact kind, not the field, and the PNG still has to satisfy every image limit: a plain 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG of at most 4 MiB (8 MiB for all images), dimensions up to 2048 pixels per axis and 1,048,576 pixels total, non-interlaced, no auxiliary chunks. Other artifact kinds (tables, audio, files, video, geometry) are refused before the report starts; a text artifact is accepted by the workflow but refused at the image block because it is not a .png path. Producers whose PNG exceeds a limit are refused, never rescaled or truncated. Place an image reference only at an image source: at an ordinary string field it becomes path text, while path fields retain their own checks (a PNG at transcript segments.path is refused as INVALID_TRANSCRIPT_SOURCE). The embedded bytes are those captured from the verified artifact; this is semantic consistency with the producing step, not signed authenticity of the picture.
- Declare metadata with authors and a description to credit the report consistently in HTML, DOCX and EPUB. It is plain text only (no keywords, dates, rights, links or markup), authors may not contain a semicolon or repeat, and it is an author declaration: no verified identity, accessibility or review is implied.

Native binding: `Pandoc JSON AST: Header / Para / Table / Image; html5 / docx writers; docx reader`. Output kind: `["text","file"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | Required report title, up to 160 plain-text characters. It appears before the first section in both outputs and labels the HTML browser tab; it is not a filename. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":160}` | **required** |
| `sections` | Ordered outline of 1–32 sections, each with a heading and content. Array order is publication order; no native sorting or implicit content is added. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"heading":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":160,"required":true},"level":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":3,"default":1},"content":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["paragraph"],"required":true},"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2048,"required":true}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["table"],"required":true},"columns":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":256,"required":true},"minItems":1,"maxItems":8,"required":true},"rows":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":256,"required":true},"minItems":1,"maxItems":8},"minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"required":true}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["image"],"required":true},"source":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"alt":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":256,"required":true},"widthMm":{"type":"number","minimum":10,"maximum":148,"default":80}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["transcript"],"required":true},"segments":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}}},"timeFormat":{"type":"enum","values":["milliseconds","timecode"]}}}]},"minItems":1,"maxItems":32,"required":true}}},"minItems":1,"maxItems":32}` | **required** |
| `epub` | Optional object that adds an EPUB 3 publication (report.epub) to the report, written by the official Pandoc EPUB 3 writer from the same trusted report model as the HTML and DOCX files: the title, headings, paragraphs, tables and embedded PNG images in authored order, one chapter file per level 1 section, with Pandoc's default stylesheet and navigation. Declare only the book language. The package is then read back by independent host code (exact ZIP framing and members, OPF manifest and spine, navigation, XHTML chapters, image bytes) and by a fresh Pandoc EPUB reader, and the report fails rather than publishing an EPUB that differs. This is a bounded structural proof, not EPUBCheck, reading-system or device rendering, or accessibility conformance. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"language":{"type":"string","minLength":2,"maxLength":35,"required":true}}}` | omitted |
| `metadata` | Optional object that declares who the report is credited to and a short summary, carried consistently by every publication: standalone HTML (author and description meta elements, and one visible author line each in the title block), Word DOCX (creator and description document properties, and one Author-style line each under the title) and, when epub is declared, EPUB 3 (one creator each and a description, and the authors on the title page). It holds only authors, description or both, as plain text. After the run each format is read back by independent code and by a fresh Pandoc reader, and the report fails instead of publishing a format whose authors or description differ, are missing or are extra. The authors and description are your declarations: nothing verifies who the authors are, that they wrote or approved the report, or that the description is accurate; the description does not imply accessibility, review or peer review. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"authors":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":100},"minItems":1,"maxItems":8},"description":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":1000}}}` | omitted |
